key_points: Q3 earnings beat expectations despite China sales decline and operating profit miss.
Kenvue acquisition closed, targeting ~$1.9 billion in cost synergies over time.
Persistent China headwinds and soft North America personal care sales weigh on organic growth.
Net ETF selling of $101.8 million on Nov 4 signals short‑term caution, likely temporary.
Operating profit fell 33% YoY, indicating margin pressure that may limit near‑term upside.
